title: Dormant Begin wire contracts and durable exact ACK
outcome: Tested unused typed Begin/persistence prerequisite, with no active recovery or cancellation-proof claim.
acceptance: Production is limited to typed format/include and unused ACK/fence. No recovery fields in live or persisted records, loader/serializer integration, admission/Begin/delivery callers, held-state policy, raw decoder or cancellation verifier; ordinary production cannot enter this support.

Round-trip and reconstruction tests preserve every original TurnBegin wire component, including routing_token, grant_id, ordered delivery_tokens and idempotency_key, plus immutable original head inputs, operation/revision, authority and phase/settlement; reconstruction consults no current routing or authority. Controls also preserve the grant basis, dispatch identity, session/project/store/connection/settings/work-binding data and distinct local prepare-ACK, result-ACK, invalid-reply and stale-owner failure kinds. These establish data contracts only, not first-send ownership, replay or provider delivery.

The unused ACK reads metadata and the complete ordered transcript from the real separate messages table on the same cached writer connection. Fixtures use the production serializer; matching, each component mismatch, absent metadata/message, SQL failure/unknown/deadline and cancellation-message-outside-resident-tail controls establish exact durable readback.
No state lock spans a persistence wait; existing fence variants and healthy persistence/admission/bind/abort/initial delivery retain their behavior under regression controls.
Documentation states dormancy and leaves raw validation, cancellation proof, foundation, automatic recovery and incident claims open. Provisional roots/logs remain preserved.

Complete-context formatted forecast and final recount precede application/landing; overrun stops for split without compression.
